name: 318-lang-opaque
description: Issue 318 fixture: a Lua producer fans out a table containing a Lua function to BOTH a Lua consumer (which calls the function) AND a write box (which forces the producer to JSON-encode for the cross-language ring). The Lua consumer reconstructs the $lang_opaque function from the producer's per-worker registry and calls it. Proves intra-Lua $lang_opaque round-trips through the JSON ring.
